name: metwally
description: VS Code front-end for the pi coding agent, built for self-hosted models (vLLM, Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, LiteLLM).

source.note: Pinned revision for reproducible builds; update deliberately after sandbox validation.

runtime.note: The extension drives the `pi` binary over line-delimited JSON-RPC. It probes nvm, /usr/local/bin and ~/.local/bin, or set piVscode.piPath.

settings.piVscode.trustProject: Required for pi to load project-local .pi/ resources. Enable only for repositories you trust.
